entity.ribbits.ribbit.description: It's a Ribbit! They thrive in their communities, but they don't mind interacting with players. Go say hi and maybe you'll find them to be useful...
item.ribbits.ribbit_nitwit_spawn_egg.des: Spawns a Nitwit Ribbit. Be nice to them, please?
Spawns a Fisherman Ribbit. Easier than using their tongue, I'm sure.
item.ribbits.ribbit_gardener_spawn_egg.d: Spawns a Gardener Ribbit. Grows their habitat by watering nearby crops.
item.ribbits.ribbit_merchant_spawn_egg.d: Spawns a Merchant Ribbit. They would be happy to trade with a player.
item.ribbits.ribbit_sorcerer_spawn_egg.d: Spawns a Sorcerer Ribbit Spawn Egg. Their spells are really helpful!
entity.crittersandcompanions.dragonfly.d: A passive mob tameable with spider eyes. Once tamed, they can be given armor!
entity.crittersandcompanions.dumbo_octop: A passive mob that spawns in deep oceans. They give nearby drowning players a bubble helment!
entity.crittersandcompanions.ferret.desc: A passive mob tameable with raw rabbit that helps you hunt chickens and rabbits. They can also dig loot for you!
entity.crittersandcompanions.jumping_spi: A passive mob tameable with dragonfly wings. Once tamed, it will protect it's owner.
entity.crittersandcompanions.koi_fish.de: A passive mob that spawns in rivers. A group of koi will give a nearby player luck!
entity.crittersandcompanions.ladybug.des: A passive mob tameable with mushrooms. Heals nearby pets.
entity.crittersandcompanions.leaf_insect: A passive mob that spawns in forests. Get them near a jukebox and watch them dance!
entity.crittersandcompanions.otter.descr: A passive mob that spawns in rivers. They will open clams to get a pearl.
entity.crittersandcompanions.red_panda.d: A passive mob tameable with sweet berries. Sleeps during day, but scares away aggressive neutral mobs!
entity.crittersandcompanions.roly_poly.d: A passive mob tameable with mushroms. Can be equipped with a chest.
entity.crittersandcompanions.sea_bunny.d: A passive mob that spawns in oceans. Interacting with a glass bottle will give you sea bunny slime.
entity.crittersandcompanions.shima_enaga: A passive mob tameable with seeds. Spawns in snowy biomes. How cute!
entity.crittersandcompanions.snail.descr: A passive mob tameable with leaves. Interacting with a glass bottle will give you snail slime.
entity.crittersandcompanions.stag_beetle: A passive mob tameable with berries. Defends the player with high damage and knockback!
entity.crittersandcompanions.stick_bug.d: A passive mob that... does nothing. But, they love to dance!
entity.crittersandcompanions.weevil.desc: A neutral mob tameable with acorns. Attacks mobs by throwing clumps of dirt.
entity.faunify.weasel.description: A passive mob tameable with raw rabbit that can dig resources for you if you drop an egg nearby.
entity.faunify.fennec.description: A passive mob tameable with raw chicken (If you lure it close!) that can alert you to nearby monsters.
entity.faunify.chinchilla.description: A passive mob tameable with dandelions that can turn gravel into useful dust.
entity.faunify.hedgehog.description: A neutral defensive mob tameable with insect flesh that periodically drop quills.
entity.faunify.ringtailcat.description: A passive mob tameable with rabbit feet that gives you haste, alerts you to nearby ores, and tunnels through soft blocks.
entity.faunify.opossum.description: A passive mob that hold their young on their backs and can harvest sweet berry bushes.
entity.faunify.mouse.description: A neutral mob that sneakily steals seeds from your inventory.
entity.faunify.silkmoth.description: A passive mob breedable by glow berries that spawn at night and despawn at day.
entity.faunify.silkworm.description: A passive mob that hatches from Silkworm Eggs that eat nearby leaves.
entity.faunify.beetle.description: A passive mob that spawns in groups of three. They do NOT drop Elytras.
entity.faunify.ladybug.description: A passive mob that spawns in groups of two. Said to be good luck, but they do nothing.
entity.faunify.weevil.description: A passive mob that will eat any crops it finds. Watch your farms!
entity.faunify.beefly.description: A skittish, passive mob able to pollenate your crops.
entity.faunify.mantis.description: A neutral mob that hunts other insects.
entity.faunify.dragonfly.description: A skittish, passive mob that spawns in groups of two. Doesn't really look like a dragon…
entity.faunify.lacewing.description: A passive mob that spawns in groups of two. Pretty cool-looking.
entity.faunify.stickbug.description: A passive mob that loves to dance, but don't let it catch you watching! Attempts to camouflage when looked at.
entity.faunify.leafinsect.description: A passive mob that spawns in groups of two. Looks just like a real leaf!
entity.faunify.grasshopper.description: A passive mob that spawns in groups of two. They love to jump!
entity.faunify.millipede.description: A passive mob that spawns alone. So many legs…
entity.faunify.millipede_body.descriptio: The body of a millipede. Long, right?
entity.faunify.millipede_tail.descriptio: The tail of a millipede. Yes, they have tails.
entity.faunify.rolypoly.description: A passive mob that curls up when frightened. When sprinted into, they can flip over, which has a variety of uses!
entity.faunify.leafsheep.description: A passive mob found at the bottom of the ocean that are a good source of slime balls.
entity.wildernature.beaver.description: A passive mob that builds dams along rivers. Give it the right items, and it'll give you stripped logs in return.
entity.wildernature.bison.description: A neutral mob that when attacked, the whole herd retaliates. Make one panic and you'll have a stampede.
entity.wildernature.boar.description: A passive mob that digs through dirt, looking for food. Handing them a Truffle encourages digging.
entity.wildernature.cassowary.descriptio: A hostile mob that is protective over her chicks. They'll warn you first, then their attacks slow you down.
entity.wildernature.deer.description: A skittish, passive mob. At night, they seek shelter and sleep. Hunting one gives you Bad Omen and Slowness.
entity.wildernature.dog.description: A loyal companion! Hides and retrieves items, warns you about creepers and racoons, and more.
entity.wildernature.elephant.description: A neutral mob that, once fed enough to gain it's trust, will let the trusted player ride it.
entity.wildernature.giraffe.description: A skittish, neutral mob. They can be ridden, but don't make it feel threatened, their kicks are powerful!
entity.wildernature.hedgehog.description: A passive defensive mob that curls up when threatened. They sleep during day and sniff for food at night.
entity.wildernature.hippo.description: A neutral mob that snaps at fish and attack boats. Don't get near them, but know that raw meat calms them down.
entity.wildernature.lion.description: A neutral mob that lives in small prides and rest during the day. Don't disturb him!
entity.wildernature.lioness.description: A neutral mob that lives in small prides and rest during the day. Don't disturb her!
entity.wildernature.minisheep.descriptio: A neutral mob that follows a leader in a herd. When sheared, drops wool.
entity.wildernature.raccoon.description: A passive but sneaky thief that open doors, loots containers and stashes their finds. They also nibble crops at night.
entity.wildernature.scorpion.description: A tameable hostile mob that ambushes anything that comes close. Their stings are poisonous!
entity.wildernature.squirrel.description: A passive mob that hoards hazelnuts. Offering them certain items raises their trust, and trusted squirrels bring you gifts.
entity.wildernature.swift_fox.descriptio: A passive mob that steals dropped and held items. Bribe them to win their trust and they'll return it... and bring gifts.
entity.wildernature.termite.description: A passive mod that gnaw on nearby logs and carry the wood home. Sometimes, they'll carry woodmeal.
entity.wildernature.turkey.description: A passive mob that lays turkey eggs.
entity.wildernature.turkey_egg.descripti: An egg laid by a turkey. When thrown, a turkey may hatch.
entity.clutterbestiary.butterfly.descrip: A passive mob that has a chance to drop Elytra Smithing Template Shards when hatched from a cocoon. Can be put in a bottle.
entity.clutterbestiary.chameleon.descrip: A passive mob tameable with apples. Will attack butterflies naturally, but attacks other mobs when tamed.
entity.clutterbestiary.echofin.descripti: A neutral mob that only spawn in the End. Occasionally attacks the player and applies effects.
entity.clutterbestiary.mossbloom.descrip: A passive mob tameable with a Spore Blossom. They are rideable, have a chance to speed crop growth, and occasionally drop their antlers.
entity.clutterbestiary.kiwi_bird.descrip: A passive mob that lays eggs when bred with seeds. They love to dance!
entity.clutterbestiary.emperor_penguin.d: A passive mob that lays eggs when bred with fish.
entity.clutterbestiary.beaver.descriptio: A passive mob that will help you strip logs and craft more sticks from planks.
entity.clutterbestiary.capybara.descript: A passive mob tameable with Melon Slices. At night when it sleeps, it heals nearby entities.
entity.clutterbestiary.jellyfish.descrip: A neutral mob that spawns in oceans and stings nearby non-aquatic entities.
entity.clutterbestiary.manta_ray.descrip: A neutral mob that spawns in oceans. Hunts nearby jellyfish.
entity.clutterbestiary.seahorse.descript: A passive mob breedable with Sea Pickles. When bred, one of the parents will hatch multiple babies.
entity.clutterbestiary.ember_tortoise.de: A neutral mob that attacks Hoglins and Zoglins. Once hurt enough, it goes into a defensive state.
entity.clutterbestiary.crimson_newt.desc: A neutral mob tameable with Weeping Vines. It grows fungi on it's back and attacks what it's owner targets.
entity.clutterbestiary.warped_newt.descr: A neutral mob tameable with Twisting Vines. It grows fungi on it's back and attacks what it's owner targets.
entity.clutterbestiary.potion_wasp.descr: A passive mob that spawns with different poison sacs. When hurt, it drops it's sac that spawns a potion cloud.
entity.clutterbestiary.dragonfly.descrip: A passive mob that occasionally hovers over lily pads.
entity.clutterbestiary.booplet.descripti: A passive mob that can be sheared for string. It also scares away zombie-like mobs!
entity.clutterbestiary.koi.description: A passive mob that spawns in oceans. Can be bred with Kelp with patterns from the parents.
